ann_audit.scope: Header/code inspection only; ANN wall time not isolated.

existing_representative_reranker_sample.scope: Representative real returned passages repeated to200pairs; offline local diagnostic under concurrent evaluation, not a quality sample or precise end-to-end component sum.

scope: Read-only hardware/code/tokenization audit. No ANN latency, new neural speedup, or quality improvement measured.

token_audit.scope: Tokenization-only audit of full source rows for final returned chunks from three recent questions, original query per question; not all original reranker candidates/facets, not a latency or accuracy measurement.

unmeasured_priorities: CPU threads and batch-shape benchmarking with unchanged full candidate pool.

Bounded parallel ANN shard search, preserving every shard, search parameters, per-shard calculations, validations and deterministic merge; ANN wall-time isolation still needed.
